local_additions.origin: All 26946 author Cardiomyocytes rows, preserving log2FoldChange and BH padj, including non-DEGs and missing padj. Canonical fields absent upstream remain empty.

notes: Reopened under ADR0073: previous 50-axis-gene cost/target rationale is not a quality exclusion. Author supplementary table is a full test table, not per-cell annotations. Tests are author DESeq2, not locally refitted. Full GEO cell objects/counts not acquired by this adapter.
